---
title: "Mallard Duck Movement"
---

Lake Constance lies in central Europe, where Germany, Switzerland, and Austria meet. This site explores GPS tracking data for mallards from 2007 to 2017, provided by the [PPBDS misc.tutorials project](https://github.com/PPBDS/misc.tutorials/blob/main/inst/tutorials/ducks/data/mallards.csv).

The recorded fixes range from 47.3°N to 53.9°N and 7.8°E to 23.6°E, showing how far some birds traveled north and east of Lake Constance. Autumn has the most recorded fixes, especially September; fix counts describe the tracking records, not necessarily how often the ducks were moving. Explore the [Map](map.qmd) and [Seasons](seasons.qmd) pages from the navbar to see the locations and monthly patterns.
